g.text: Child forecasts and wind and solar columns do not lower the BSP or GSP score

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero favours the first arm. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.17% interval for planned rows (Bonferroni across six) and 95% for exploratory rows, from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather.'
text.tspan: Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero
favours the first arm. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.17% interval for planned rows (Bonferroni
across six) and 95% for exploratory rows, from re-drawing whole months and seeds. 73
forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather.
